name: Melhorias de Rituais + Surrender
description: Expanded Ritual Summoning (v1.3.5), plus Select-to-Surrender against CPU: native Yes/No confirmation, Yes follows the ordinary LOSE result flow, No resumes the duel. No ritual rules changed.
author: Otavio

settings.label: Minimum tributes on Field
settings.description: Minimum number of the 3 Ritual tributes that must already be on the field. 3 gives Vanilla tribute placement.

settings.label: Use tributes from Deck
settings.description: Allows missing Ritual tributes to be taken from the undrawn Deck.

settings.label: Minimum tributes in Hand
settings.description: Minimum number of Ritual tributes that must be in the hand when Deck tributes are enabled.

settings.label: Require Ritual Monster card
settings.description: Require the summoned Ritual Monster itself. Hand requires the real copy in hand; Hand or Deck accepts hand or the undrawn deck and consumes that physical copy.

settings.label: Player must Ritual Summon Ritual Monsters
settings.description: Prevents human players from placing Ritual-result monsters directly from the hand. CPU play is unchanged. With Require Ritual Monster = Hand or Deck, player Ritual-result cards start at the bottom of the shuffled deck.
